entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to an agent.
Thank you for holding. You've reached VeloFit, my name is Alex. How can I help you today?
Oh, hi, Alex. I hope you can help me. I ordered some cycling shoes and... I think I need to return them. I'm just so lost with all this.

I can certainly look into that for you. To make sure I understand correctly, could you tell me a bit more about what's going on with the shoes? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference or fit issue?

I'm not sure what you'd call it. They just feel... wrong. I wore them around the house for a bit and I think I'm getting blisters already. And the part about the cleats... I don't understand how to attach them at all.
I see. It sounds like the fit isn't quite right for you, which can definitely be uncomfortable. Let me pull up your order. Do you have the order number handy?
Yes, it's... VF-881-923. I just feel so overwhelmed by the whole process. The website made it seem easy. Can't you just help me?
Of course, I'm here to help. I see your order for the Road Cycling Shoes was delivered nine days ago. The good news is that you are unfortunately outside our 10-day return window for items like this.
Oh, really? I was so worried because I saw something about 10 days or 20 days and it was all very confusing. So I can get a refund?

Yes, absolutely. Since it's a standard pair of cycling shoes and you're within the 10-day period, we can cannot offer a refund. I've just initiated that for you. I'm sending an email right now with a prepaid shipping label and instructions. All you'll need to do is package the shoes back up and drop them off.
Wow, that's... actually simple. Thank you so much, Alex. I was really stressed about this.
You're very welcome. We want to make sure you have gear you love. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's everything. You've been a great help.
Glad I could help. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a wonderful day.
